name: Sun Odyssey 44i - Jeanneau
description: A sailing monohull designed by Philippe Briand to sail well, and sailed here by a captain who knows her inside out.
details:
A sailing monohull designed by Philippe Briand to sail well, and sailed here by a captain who knows her inside out.
Her sails are in good shape and she is simple to handle: if you want to take the helm or help with a manoeuvre, he'll show you how.
If not, he takes care of everything.

There's no daylight-only rule on board. When the weather calls for it, she leaves at 4 a.m. while you sleep, or reaches the anchorage at 10 p.m. after a passage under the stars. Below deck: three double cabins, three bathrooms with separate showers, air conditioning and a bright saloon to end the day in.
features: Philippe Briand design, built for performance under sail
Captain who knows the boat inside out; guests can learn to helm and trim
Sails at any hour: early starts and night passages possible
